# Color

Convert colours between HEX, RGB, HSL and HSV, with a swatch and WCAG contrast.

Category: Converters · ID: `color` · Search terms: colour, hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, css, contrast

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui color [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Colour (#hex, rgb(), hsl() or a CSS name)

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/color`), so they are what the tool prints.

### hsla-css4

```text
HEX:      #2966a340
RGB:      rgba(41, 102, 163, 0.25)
HSL:      hsla(210, 60%, 40%, 0.25)
HSV:      hsv(210, 75%, 64%)
Contrast: 5.96:1 on white, 3.52:1 on black
```

### rebeccapurple

```text
HEX:      #663399
RGB:      rgb(102, 51, 153)
HSL:      hsl(270, 50%, 40%)
HSV:      hsv(270, 66.7%, 60%)
Name:     rebeccapurple
Contrast: 8.41:1 on white, 2.50:1 on black
```
